what.text: This page follows internal displacement in Saint-Martin (French part), as recorded by IDMC.
In 2017, IDMC recorded 3114 new displacements by disasters: these count movements, not people.

why.text: IDMC's disaster records for Saint-Martin (French part) list storms.
The fact pack records no armed conflict for Saint-Martin (French part).

when.text: 2017 is the only year with a figure in IDMC's data.
The data shows no year-end count of people still displaced.

how.text: The sources don't say where people went.
New displacements count movements, not people, and are shown on their own chart.
